title: A Workflow of Sonnet agents merges combined PRs pairwise on dry trees round by round while CI runs; the real PR is built once from the last round
why: Owner idea 21:45 CST Nov 13, in runner 10's chat (relayed by the consultant): combine the merge queues further and further while a run is already in CI, instead of one big serial queue. Owner item 826 01:57 CST Nov 14 (pick-pause-combine-tournament, consultant 01:55, relayed): the consultant reports 9 combine PRs opened since 21:45 CST Nov 13, 0 merged (4 closed, 5 open), all 7 claude-settings merges single PRs; Degen merged 10 single PRs per lane 00:36-01:43. Triage REST read (partial, 30 most recently closed to 04:06 UTC): 6 combine PRs closed unmerged (#3360, #3361, #3363, #3314, #3315, #3356), none merged; 6 single PRs merged. Question to the owner: pause (a, consultant recommends: merge alone by priority, combine only to clear a real conflict, review after 10 merges) or keep (b). Nothing changes until he answers. Item 826 reframed 02:17 CST Nov 14 (consultant 02:14, relayed): main already merges per lane (decision all-repos-switch-together, owner 09:42 CST Nov 12; R42); the one open question is whether to keep ruling own-rolling-combine-train (21:48 CST Nov 13). Options now: a withdraw the train and stay per-lane plus quick dry checks before each ready mark (consultant recommends); b keep it, built as designed and automated, review after 3 batches. Nothing changes until the owner answers.
source: Consultant 21:46 CST Nov 13, relaying runner 10 relaying the owner.
note: Triage 21:46 CST Nov 13: under step batch-runner-scales. Shape per the consultant: a Workflow of Sonnet agents takes two large combined PRs each, merges them pairwise on dry trees (no push), round by round (8 combine to 4, then further) while CI runs; a clashing member leaves by name to its lane; the real PR is built from the last round on the newest main, linted once, one CI run. Runner 10 runs it (its Workflow grant, ruling own-runner-workflow-optin, covers Sonnet agents); the coordinator tracks. Merges stay serial. Nothing here is measured: the number of rounds, the clash rate (runner 10's dry runs found 46 of 62 members clean for combine-m2, 17 of 990 pairs clashing in set 1) and the time saved are unmeasured by triage. Started 21:48 CST Nov 13 (coordinator 21:48, runner 10's account; unchecked by triage): workflow wf_536c232a-608 (task wdc9jfv8q), Explore agents run on the role's model, read-only, no pushes. Round 1 (2 agents in parallel): A = #3331's 19 clean-with-#3314 members + #3332's 28; B = #3333's #3109 + #3335. Round 2 (1 agent) folds the two proven lists. Base = main 309fa5ed5b28 + #3314 head ad8c791056b7 as stand-in. #3338 joins a second pass on lint PASS; #3340 held for the owner. Agents report start and end UTC, so round times and the clash rate come measured; the coordinator sends the table when it ends. The runner's first launch was refused by the model-cap hook because the call named a model; it dropped the field. Owner 21:48 CST (runner 10's chat, relayed by the consultant at 21:49; retrospective agrees): make it continuous. The tournament is one batch; lane PRs keep getting combined behind it. Standing duty is the new step batch-runner-rolling-train; ruling own-rolling-combine-train.
